title: The reviewer has two sides
statement: The header divides the application into Documentation, what it is, and Review, how it is changing.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The header offers Documentation and Review, and each opens its own side.
Reviews and the views that read a comparison appear under Review only, never in the documentation sidebar.
A feature, story, or acceptance criterion lists the reviews that changed the code it explains, derived from the diffs rather than authored.
The list says it was derived, so a reader does not mistake it for a claim someone made.
